entities.summary: The State Television and Radio Fund, also known as the Gosteleradiofond is a Russian archive that is a branch of the Federal State Unitary Enterprise, the All-Russia State Television and Radio Broadcasting Company (VGTRK). The Gosteleradiofond archives television and radio broadcasting programs that were recorded before 1999.
